text.p: Average yields at auctions of Ukrainian six-, nine-, 12- and 18-month treasury bills fell from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.

Six-month bills eased to 19.88 percent from 19.91 percent, nine-month bills fell to 21.95 percent from 23.91 percent, 12-month bills edged down to 23.35 percent from 24.23 percent and 18-month bills slithered down to 26.00 from 26.75 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.60 million UAH 12.60 million UAH
Amount sold 6.40 million UAH 10.22 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.82 million UAH 9.29 million UAH
The central bank sold 126,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 38.00 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Amount sold 38.00 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 32.64 million UAH 32.23 million UAH
The central bank sold 380,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 26.60 million UAH 26.60 million UAH
Amount sold 26.60 million UAH 26.60 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.57 million UAH 21.42 million UAH
The central bank sold 266,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills was not announced.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Amount sold 31.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.32 million UAH 22.14 million UAH
The central bank sold 310,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
